name: Orveia
source:
Two friends find themselves in a strange new world, but something's... different. They'll have to work together to find an escape, but do they even want to leave?

[From [url=https://orveia.itch.io/orveia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个朋友发现自己身处一个陌生的新世界，但有些东西……不同了。他们必须共同努力寻找逃生之路，但他们真的想离开吗？
